# AddaxAI Connect payloads

Shapes taken from the AddaxAI Connect API code (`services/api/routers/images.py`,
`ImageListItemResponse` and `PaginatedImagesResponse`; `services/api/routers/cameras.py`,
`CameraResponse`). Values are invented; they are not recordings from a server. Replace them
with recorded responses from the live run.

- `images_page.json`: one page of `GET /api/images?sort=newest`.
- `cameras.json`: `GET /api/cameras`.
